title: Cognitive AI framework 2.0: advances in the simulation of human thought

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure or benchmark specific biases; instead, it proposes a theoretical framework that mitigates cognitive and implicit biases. The proposed methodology involves integrating operational controls into the AI architecture, such as provenance metadata, confidence scores, expiration parameters, diversity-aware retrieval strategies, and uncertainty calibration to prevent the long-term entrenchment of biased or erroneous information.
